title: In the Tall, Tall Grass  (Nature Read Aloud)
fulltitle: In the Tall, Tall Grass  (Nature Read Aloud)
description:
In the Tall, Tall Grass” by Denise Fleming is a colorful children’s picture book about a small caterpillar exploring a grassy backyard. As the caterpillar moves through the tall grass, it encounters different insects and animals—like ants, bees, birds, and snakes—while the story uses rhyming words and sound effects to describe what they are doing. The journey begins during the day and ends at night, showing children the lively world of nature hidden in the grass.

title: Crazy Pizza Day  ( Animated Read Aloud)
fulltitle: Crazy Pizza Day  ( Animated Read Aloud)
description:
“Crazy Pizza Day” by Bonnie Dobkin (illustrated by George Ermos) is a fun and silly children’s book about a pizza shop that has a very unusual day of business!. The story takes place in a pizza parlor where the owner announces it’s Crazy Pizza Day! On this special day, customers can order any kind of pizza they want — no matter how wild or strange.

Children come in and request all sorts of crazy combinations:

Peanut butter and jelly pizza

Banana and tuna pizza

Pickle and ice cream pizza

Even bubble gum pizza!

The shop owner and workers make every bizarre pizza with a smile, having fun with the silly requests. But as the day goes on, things get even wilder — the toppings get messier, the shop gets crowded, and chaos starts to take over.

Finally, at the end of the day, the pizza maker declares, “No more crazy pizzas — tomorrow, it’s back to normal pizza day!”

Themes and Lessons:

Creativity: Encourages kids to think outside the box.

Fun with food: Shows how imagination can turn something ordinary (like pizza) into something exciting.

Order and routine: Even though it’s fun to be silly, it’s also good to have structure and balance.

Reading Level:
It’s a rhyming picture book for early readers (typically preschool–grade 2). It’s great for classroom storytime because kids love to shout out the silly toppings!

Pete thinks he found a new best friend. But when his caterpillar goes missing, Pete has to find out what happened to his new friend. Pete is in for one wild surprise at the end!

Pete the Cat and the Cool Caterpillar is a Level I Can Read book, complete with original illustrations from the creator of Pete the Cat, James Dean, and is perfect for children learning to sound out words and sentences.
